verdict.rationale: Vanta's Trust Center is documented as showing "live controls" alongside docs in a branded portal, which implies control status flows from the platform without manual updates. Nothing ties subprocessor lists or document renewals to automatic Trust Center updates; vendor discovery in TPRM is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: automatic subprocessor-list sync to the Trust Center, automated document renewal/expiry updates, in-depth docs on how live control data refreshes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
